fixes.title: Brief the angle before the script
fixes.what: Give the AI three lines first: the angle, the hook, and the must-say facts. Add three past scripts as voice examples.
fixes.catch: It can still invent prices or places. Check every number before recording.

fixes.title: Export once, not twice
fixes.what: Add filters and music in the same pass, export once, then check colour and volume on that final file.
fixes.catch: If the music changes after the check, you are back to two exports.

fixes.title: One pass for covers and captions
fixes.what: Ask the AI once for cover titles, frame suggestions, captions and hashtags in both languages.
fixes.catch: Keep your own final read of anything platform-sensitive.

fixes.title: Fix colour drift at the source
fixes.what: Test one clip shot with HDR off, lock one export preset, and compare colour readings instead of eyeballing.
fixes.catch: HDR is a likely cause, not a confirmed one. Run both checks on three videos first.

fixes.title: Batch your voiceovers
fixes.what: Record two to three scripts in one quiet, high-energy session.
fixes.catch: Needs scripts ready ahead of time.

fixes.title: Plan per trip, not per video
fixes.what: Turn each trip's footage into five to eight video ideas with angle, hook and clip list, scheduled in one sitting.
fixes.catch: Ideas are only as good as the clip labels. Watch the clips for your top two ideas first.

need: Editing keeps eating 4 full hours or more per one minute video, and I can't post more often.
fear: AI edits that look generic, or colour and caption mistakes slipping through.
